title: operator-inbox-is-deterministic-python
what: The operator inbox is a deterministic Python script that reads live state and produces OperatorInbox.md — it cannot report stale data because it stores none.
how: A Python script (bin/cmd/operator_inbox or a cairn verb) that reads each data source directly: troubles (standing field), gate findings (learning_block.pending_findings), questions (CairnCommons/questions/), tickets (CairnCommons/tickets/ state fields), intentions (CairnCommons/intentions-not-beside-code/), ideas (CairnCommons/ideas/), bus messages to operator (shim unresolved-messages query). Writes OperatorInbox.md with sections ordered by expected-emptiness: totals, troubles, email, adjudications, questions, design, tickets, intentions, ideas. 'Operator' replaces 'Akien' throughout. Replaces the whatslefttodo LLM skill.
traces_to: Law 1 (the resolver spent on the novel — the script retires the re-derivation of the inbox), Law 3 (every figure is a live measurement), Law 10 (the script's output IS the observation)
falsifier: Run the script. Its output matches the live state of every source it reads — zero stale figures, zero missed items, zero sections reporting from stored data. If it reports 3 troubles when there are 0, the intent was wrong. If an operator has to ask CC 'what's left to do' instead of running the script, the intent was wrong.

watchme.trigger: every run of the operator inbox script — the probe reads the output and independently checks each section's count against the live source
watchme.enough: three consecutive runs where every section's count matches the independent check, across at least one state change
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against this ticket's falsifier
watchme.consumer: the operator and the whatslefttodo skill's successor charter

gates_bound.build: the build gate inspects the script, its readers, and its output format
gates_bound.proof: run the script; diff its output against independent reads of each source; zero stale figures

children: none — single script plus its proof
